upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview.appspot.com code review server
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a patch diff against a specified revision using git, hg, or svn version control
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate to the code review server using google clientlogin credentials and save cookies
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP POST requests
split_patch_by_file: split a combined svn-style diff output into separate patches for each individual file
